people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
translations.bsb: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
translations.kjv: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
translations.asv: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
